fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reports on post-NRA labor standards and calls for businesses to maintain fair wages and hours; an exposé on illegal marble board gambling operations in Miami (including concerns about minors gambling and syndicate control); advocacy to end dog racing in Dade County via petition and referendum; political rumors and appointments in Florida and Miami; a report that Miami Beach Mayor Louis A. Snedigar may resign following an auto accident; campus and sports columns (University of Miami notes, Indianapolis Speedway critique, horse-racing tips); and extensive local merchant advertising.
